shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher, Fisher Yu, co-founder of Bitcoin staking protocol Babylon, proposed stopping staking reward distributions and accepting new stakes at year-end while keeping existing withdrawal rules in place. The proposal comes as Babylon shifts its focus toward Bitcoin-backed collateral.
